name: paper-reader-local

scripts.test: npm run build:markdown && npm run build:link && node scripts/run-tests.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build:markdown && npm run build:link && node scripts/prepare-desktop-runtime.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --win portable --x64

author: Paper Reader
